entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The culmination of the fight between Nicol Bolas and the Gatewatch on Ravnica.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon planeswalker who claims dominion over Ravnica and casts the Elderspell; killed by Liliana's betrayal and Bontu, and later reborn powerless in the Meditation Realm.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker group, led by Jace Beleren and Gideon Jura, that fights Bolas.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild city plane where the war takes place.

entities.name: Elderspell
entities.description: The spell that harvests the sparks of planeswalkers and would grant Bolas godhood.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: An artifact Bolas uses to trap planeswalkers on Ravnica.

entities.name: Interplanar Beacon
entities.description: A device Ral activates to lure planeswalkers to Ravnica.

entities.name: Eternals
entities.description: Bolas' relentless army that slaughters civilians and harvests sparks.

entities.name: God-Eternals
entities.description: The undead gods Bolas brings through the portal: Oketra, Bontu, Rhonas, Kefnet and Hazoret.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A Gatewatch leader who recommends splitting into teams and creates an illusion of Bolas' corpse.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A Gatewatch leader who kills Rhonas, strikes Bolas with the Blackblade, and dies taking Liliana's contract.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who disables and later reactivates the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who animates Vitu-Ghazi and leads the ritual repairing the leylines.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker serving Bolas who leads the Dreadhorde, then betrays him.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Bolas' planeswalker servant who opens the Planar Bridge to Amonkhet and is defeated.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker who took over the Izzet League, activates the Interplanar Beacon, and rallies the guilds.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: A planeswalker who took over the Orzhov Syndicate after killing the Obzedat and who joins the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker who took over the Golgari Swarm after assassinating Jarad and who kills Isperia.

entities.name: Domri Rade
entities.description: A planeswalker who took over the Gruul Clans and is the first planeswalker to be drained of his spark.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A planeswalker who rises in the Azorius Senate, becomes its guildmaster, and guards the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The Izzet dragon who is killed, resurrected as the new Living Guildpact, and impales Bolas with Hazoret's spear.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: The Azorius guildmaster killed by Vraska.

entities.name: Hekara
entities.description: A Rakdos emissary who is murdered and later resurrected.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: An Azorius ally in the plan to unite the guilds.

entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: A planeswalker thief killed by Eternals who harvest his spark.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A planeswalker who goes through the Planar Bridge to shut the portal.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet who gives the planeswalkers her spear.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who comes back to Ravnica with the group from Amonkhet and works with Ugin.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: A God-Eternal killed by Gideon with the Blackblade.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: A God-Eternal incinerated by Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: A God-Eternal controlled by Liliana, freed by her, and obliterated by Bolas.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: A God-Eternal who bites Bolas, harvests his sparks and spark, and explodes.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The demon who catches Gideon and attacks Bolas.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A dragon planeswalker, Bolas' brother, who takes Bolas to the Meditation Realm and merges with it.

entities.name: Blackblade
entities.description: A blade Gideon wields that shatters against Bolas, who enchanted it thousands of years ago.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The Selesnyan guildhall tree animated by Nissa and torn apart by the God-Eternals.

entities.name: Living Guildpact
entities.description: The role that grants power over the guilds' agreement, held by Jace and later Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Meditation Realm
entities.description: The plane where Ugin takes Bolas and where both are trapped forever.

entities.name: Obzedat
entities.description: The ghostly Orzhov leaders killed by Kaya before she took over the Orzhov Syndicate.

events.summary: Bolas conspires to replace the guild leaders of Ravnica with planeswalkers he can influence.
events.quote: Bolas conspires to overthrow the leaders of Ravnica's guilds and replace them with Planeswalkers that he can influence

events.summary: Ral, Kaya and Vraska conspire against Bolas, planning to make Niv-Mizzet the new Living Guildpact.
events.quote: Ral, Kaya, and Vraska conspire against Bolas, realizing the dragon's treacherous nature.

events.summary: Vraska kills Isperia in a fit of rage at the guild summit, breaking down negotiations and making Dovin the Azorius guildmaster.
events.quote: Vraska kills Isperia in a fit of rage

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet fights Bolas without the Guildpact and is killed, Hekara is murdered, and Vraska flees to Ixalan.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet attempts to fight Bolas without the power of the Guildpact , and ends up getting killed.

events.summary: Ral activates the Interplanar Beacon to lure planeswalkers to Ravnica.
events.quote: Ral activates the Interplanar Beacon to lure Planeswalkers from across the multiverse to Ravnica

events.summary: The Gatewatch travels to Ravnica to confront Bolas.
events.quote: The Gatewatch travels to Ravnica, intending to confront Bolas.

events.summary: Bolas activates the Immortal Sun, trapping the assembled planeswalkers on Ravnica.
events.quote: Bolas activates the Immortal Sun , which traps the assembled Planeswalkers on Ravnica.

events.summary: Tezzeret opens the Planar Bridge to Amonkhet, letting Liliana lead the Dreadhorde through, and destroys the Embassy of the Guildpact, making Jace lose the Living Guildpact power.
events.quote: causing Jace to lose the power of the Living Guildpact

events.summary: Bolas' Eternals invade Ravnica, slaughtering civilians to lure out planeswalkers.
events.quote: Bolas' Eternals invade Ravnica, indiscriminately slaughtering civilians to lure out Planeswalkers.

events.summary: The Boros Legion, with Gideon's help, counterattacks and initially drives back the invaders.
events.quote: With the help of Gideon , their assault is initially successful in driving back the invaders.

events.summary: Nissa animates Vitu-Ghazi and topples Bolas' statue, boosting Ravnican morale.
events.quote: She uses the massive elemental to topple Bolas' statue

events.summary: The God-Eternals destroy Vitu-Ghazi and the Boros troops retreat.
events.quote: The undead gods quickly destroy Vitu-Ghazi, tearing it to pieces.

events.summary: Bolas casts the Elderspell and Domri becomes the first planeswalker drained of his spark and killed.
events.quote: Domri, despite pledging his loyalty to Bolas, is the first Planeswalker to be drained of his spark and killed.

events.summary: Gideon kills the God-Eternal Rhonas with the Blackblade.
events.quote: Gideon kills Rhonas using the Blackblade , completely draining the god's essence.

events.summary: Ral and Maree disable the Interplanar Beacon by draining its power supply.
events.quote: They succeed by draining the device's power supply.

events.summary: Lazav disguises as Chandra so she can disable the Immortal Sun, and he defeats and blinds Dovin, who planeswalks away.
events.quote: Lazav defeats Dovin and leaves him blinded, forcing him to planeswalk away.

events.summary: Karn, Ob Nixilis, Dack and Samut defeat Tezzeret on Amonkhet, closing the portal, and meet Hazoret, who gives them her spear.
events.quote: On Amonkhet, they defeat Tezzeret , causing the portal to close.

events.summary: Jace, Jaya, Teferi and Vivien nearly assassinate Liliana, but Bolas intervenes to save her.
events.quote: They almost succeed, but Bolas intervenes to save her.

events.summary: Kaya's team wins over the neutral guilds, with Vraska returned and Hekara resurrected, and Lavinia brings the Azorius on board.
events.quote: With some help from a returned Vraska and a resurrected Hekara, they succeed.

events.summary: With all ten guilds united, Nissa and the representatives repair the leylines and resurrect Niv-Mizzet as the new Living Guildpact.
events.quote: resurrects Niv-Mizzet as the new Living Guildpact

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet destroys the God-Eternal Kefnet but is left unconscious.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet uses his newfound power to destroy Kefnet

events.summary: Gideon has Chandra reactivate the Immortal Sun to trap Bolas on Ravnica.
events.quote: Gideon has Chandra reactivate the Immortal Sun, trapping the elder dragon on Ravnica.

events.summary: During the final assault on Bolas' Citadel, Dack is killed by Eternals who harvest his spark.
events.quote: During the battle, Dack is killed by Eternals, who harvest his spark.

events.summary: Oketra, controlled by Liliana, shoots down Gideon's pegasus, Liliana choosing to hit the pegasus rather than Gideon.
events.quote: Liliana, who chooses to 'miss' by hitting the pegasus instead of Gideon himself

events.summary: Rakdos brings Gideon within striking distance but is knocked out, and Gideon's Blackblade shatters against Bolas, who had enchanted it.
events.quote: Bolas reveals he enchanted the Blackblade thousands of years ago, preventing it from being able to harm an elder dragon again.

events.summary: Liliana betrays Bolas; he cancels her demonic pact, and Gideon uses hieromancy to take the contract himself, dying in her place.
events.quote: Gideon uses his hieromancy to transfer the contract to himself, killing him in her place.

events.summary: Liliana frees Oketra and Bontu, who attack Bolas of their own volition.
events.quote: Liliana frees the God-Eternals Oketra and Bontu , who attack Bolas of their own volition.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet stabs Bolas with Hazoret's spear and Bontu bites him, harvesting his sparks and spark before she explodes.
events.quote: Bolas still manages to knock out Niv and obliterate Oketra, but not before Bontu bites him

events.summary: Ugin takes Bolas' body to the Meditation Realm and has Jace create an illusion of the corpse disintegrating.
events.quote: Ugin arrives to bring Bolas' body to the Meditation Realm to prevent him from coming back to life on Ravnica.

events.summary: The Ravnicans hold a Planewide Celebration and Kaya joins the Gatewatch.
events.quote: Kaya joins the Gatewatch.

events.summary: Ral, Kaya and Vraska are told to atone by bringing Bolas' other planeswalkers to justice.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet and the other guild leaders declare that Ral, Kaya, and Vraska must atone for helping Bolas.

events.summary: Months later Bolas is reborn in the Meditation Realm completely powerless.
events.quote: Months later, Bolas is reborn in the Meditation Realm but finds himself completely powerless

events.summary: Ugin reveals he orchestrated Bolas' defeat with Niv-Mizzet and Sarkhan, and merges with the Meditation Realm, sealing it with Bolas inside.
events.quote: Ugin expands himself throughout the plane, revealing that he's merged his essence with the Meditation Realm.
